title: Eastern Fried Rice
description: A classic quick and easy eastern dish made with leftover rice and a variety of vegetables. This recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the scrambled eggs to the skillet and cook until they are set, breaking them up with a spatula as they cook.
Add the diced onion, carrot, and cabbage to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender-crisp.
Add the cooked rice to the skillet and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, breaking up any clumps with a spatula.
Add the soy sauce, salt, and pepper to the skillet and stir-fry for another minute.
Transfer the fried rice to a serving platter and serve hot.
Garnish with chopped green onions and serve immediately.
